showSets similarly constructs shortened directory-pair key; requires exactly2 unique parent paths, puts others in unpaired, and moves singleton sets there. This is navigation grouping, not all-pairs equivalence or complete-link confirmation.

Default thumbnail aspect3/4 causes center cropping; video thumbnail uses automatic fast frameGrab. Display may omit content regions and does not certify requested matching frame or entire video equality.

show rejects any empty group by returning0; empty result also returns0. Return code does not distinguish no results from invalid group input or completed review. Modal qApp exec caveat explicitly noted; no GUI verification.

showIndex stores pointer to caller-local folders map while event loop active. Hover copies group list and checks only first group length before animation indexes later groups. Lifetime and empty later-group behavior need actual UI tests; no blanket dangling pointer claim.
